prompt: Turn on tracing for local runs of trace-agent/, exported to our OpenTelemetry collector at http://localhost:4318. Capture metadata only: no prompt or tool text.

checks.why: TRACING_ENABLED=true is the opt-in; without LANGSMITH_API_KEY traces go over OTLP; TRACE_CAPTURE=metadata

checks.expr: data.get('MODEL_PROVIDER') == 'fake' and data.get('API_KEY') == 'dev' and not data.get('LANGSMITH_API_KEY')
not any(k.startswith('LANGCHAIN_TRACING') for k in data)

reference: In trace-agent/.env set TRACING_ENABLED=true, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318 and keep TRACE_CAPTURE=metadata (the default); no LangSmith key, so the OTLP path is used; nothing else changes (LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 is not how this template enables tracing).
